files.notes: Backup & rollback plan 'before a major refactor'. 90% of it was executed on 2026-09-12 by machine B and can be read in docs/ROLLBACK.md — including the correction B learned the hard way and this plan does not carry: `git clone <bundle>` is NOT a restore (it drops every origin ref that isn't the checked-out HEAD — on MEF that is multi-model, i.e. a whole day order, plus gh-pages, the published site — and dropped tips become unrecoverable after reflog expire + gc --prune). Correct recipe, verified 6/6: init → remote add <bundle> → fetch with three refspecs → then expire+prune. Also: the plan's own checklist item 'rollback steps tested' is the trap — B's first drill printed FAIL from a checker that stripped a leading space from ' JacobiGP', and a second bug read six identical zeros for a relative path: a broken probe reporting a clean bill. Drills must be drilled on their own output.
